push    rbp
mov     rbp, rsp
mov     [rbp+year], edi
mov     [rbp+month], rsi
mov     [rbp+day], rdx
mov     eax, [rbp+year]
mov     ecx, 4
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     [rbp+a], edx
mov     eax, [rbp+year]
mov     ecx, 7
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     [rbp+b], edx
mov     eax, [rbp+year]
mov     ecx, 13h
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     [rbp+c], edx
imul    eax, [rbp+c], 13h
add     eax, 0Fh
mov     ecx, 1Eh
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     [rbp+d], edx
mov     eax, [rbp+a]
shl     eax, 1
mov     ecx, [rbp+b]
shl     ecx, 2
add     eax, ecx
sub     eax, [rbp+d]
add     eax, 22h ; '"'
mov     ecx, 7
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     [rbp+e], edx
mov     eax, [rbp+d]
add     eax, [rbp+e]
add     eax, 72h ; 'r'
mov     ecx, 1Fh
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     [rbp+f], eax
mov     eax, [rbp+d]
add     eax, [rbp+e]
add     eax, 72h ; 'r'
mov     ecx, 1Fh
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     [rbp+g], edx
mov     ecx, [rbp+f]
mov     rax, [rbp+month]
mov     [rax], ecx
mov     ecx, [rbp+g]
add     ecx, 1
mov     rax, [rbp+day]
mov     [rax], ecx
pop     rbp
retn
